reference: Engineering expectations from visual inspection of public MEVA footage, not independent human ground truth. Daylight footage; R3 active hours are explicitly overridden to all day for this configured-boundary demonstration. The kerb-waiting case lowers the R1 dwell threshold from 120 s to a disclosed 90 s demo setting, because no public clip in the set has a person staying 120 s; two people waiting about 112 s for a pick-up are genuine footage, normal activity, and should be dismissed by a reviewer. Source dates are preserved under the existing MYT testing convention.
